messages:
Marta (mktg): Quick sync — we want to announce Optimize v2 tomorrow. Need: final changelog snippet, docs URL, and rollout timing. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/520 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-preview . Can eng lock schedule by EOD PT?

Theo (eng): Proposed timeline: internal smoke at 08:00 PT, public canary 09:30 PT (5%), demo pinned for webinar at 10:15 PT, staged promote to 100% by 12:30 PT if green. I'll add rollback steps to the changelog.

Emily (docs): I added the quickstart and a Console latency screenshot. Final docs URL will be https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 by 16:00 PT. Also added a short rollback FAQ.

Priya (prod-marketing): Need the headline benchmark line (latency @4k and cost delta) for the hero card. Theo?

Theo (eng): Use: "~38% median latency reduction at 4k context; ~30% token cost reduction with new batching defaults." I'll paste a short blurb to changelog now.

Marta (mktg): Alerting: page #eng-oncall if error rate > 0.8% during rollout. Can we get that rule in place?

Theo (eng): Yes — adding alert and tagging it in the rollout notes.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Theo at 2026-03-30T09:30:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Theo (eng): Canary live (5%). Health checks green. Demo pinned to variant optimize-v2-demo for webinar.

Marta (mktg): Docs link and benchmark line noted. We'll aim to publish marketing at 12:45 PT. Priya, queue socials for that slot unless eng asks to pause.

Priya (prod-marketing): Queued for 12:45 PT. Routing: demo leads -> demo-ops@redwood.ai; SDRs get enriched list after 45m.

Theo (eng): Promotion to 100% planned at 12:30 PT if all clear. Rollback command in changelog: `rwi rollback --release optimize-v2`.

Marta (mktg): Thanks — will finalize press kit and update the launch checklist. Will follow up with a quick retro tomorrow. :rocket:
